title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_replayed}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 — notification emitted by maint.dlq.v1 after a replay run completes for a single (topic, request_id). `replayed_count` may be 0 (gating succeeded but bus drain primitive not yet wired in v1).

visit_count.description: Which visit this replay was (1 = first, etc.).

budget_per_topic.description: Phase 8 §8.5 C1: per-topic share of the round-robin tick budget.

active_topic_count.description: Phase 8 §8.5 C1: how many DLQ topics shared the budget this tick.

scheduler.description: Phase 8 §8.5 C1: who triggered this replay — an operator request or the periodic round-robin scheduler.
